title: Old Acquaintance
prompt:
Rhea faces Jeralt with calm recognition; Jeralt remains guarded and uncomfortable, refusing to fully relax. Byleth stands beside Jeralt, silent and unreadable. Seteth watches from Rhea's side. The motion is restrained: Rhea inclines her head slightly, Jeralt's shoulders tense, Byleth observes.

Camera: slow cross-axis drift between Rhea's light and Jeralt's shadow. Rhea must remain a breathtakingly beautiful young adult woman in her mid-20s with smooth youthful skin; express ancient dragon divinity through calm sacred authority, not wrinkles, eye bags, tired texture, or middle-aged features.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: melodrama, shouting, exaggerated bowing, sudden confrontation. Avoid old Rhea, middle-aged Rhea, tired priestess face, wrinkles, eye bags. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
